summary: Comprehensive test suite covering core requirements: cartesian product expansion, exclude/include semantics, validation, CLI I/O, and GitHub Actions workflow integration. Unit tests (MatrixGenerator.Tests.ps1) are well-structured with clear describe blocks and fixtures for each function. Integration tests (Workflow.Tests.ps1) validate the workflow via act with multiple configuration scenarios and exact output matching. Strengths: good separation of concerns, error scenarios tested (missing files, malformed JSON, size limits, empty results), helper functions for test setup, proper cleanup. Gaps: ConvertTo-Hashtable utility not directly tested, integration test output parsing uses regex matching rather than full JSON validation, some edge cases (duplicate dimensions, complex nested includes, special characters) not explicitly tested. The suite would catch most regressions and validates that the matrix generator works end-to-end through GitHub Actions.
